description: Free agent-readiness report for one website, the same one people get at https://onlinewebdirectory.net/check: a score out of 100 and nine items (access, bot wall, JavaScript, robots.txt rules for GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and Google-Extended, llms.txt, MCP server card, API catalog, x402 paid access, claimed or not), each with a state (pass, warn, fail, missing, unknown) and points. Results are cached for 24 hours; fresh checks are rationed, and past the ration the report uses what the registry already has. Use it to tell a site owner what to fix; use lookup_origin before fetching a site yourself.

host.description: Hostname to check, for example example.com. No scheme or path; www. and case are normalised.

name: check_domain
title: Score a website's readiness for AI agents
